turns.text: Hi! I'm Alex Lin. I'm a product manager at an internet company in Beijing, and work has been pretty hectic lately.
Nice to meet you, Alex! Product work does move fast. What are you working on these days?
Features for short-video recommendations. Oh, and I adopted a golden retriever last weekend. His name is Max.
Congratulations! Goldens are gentle dogs, and Max sounds adorable. Want a checklist for new dog owners?
I want to buy a new laptop, budget around 8,000 RMB. Mostly for writing docs, with some video editing now and then.
That budget gets you a good thin-and-light or an all-rounder. Do you care more about portability or performance?
I don't like heavy machines. Ideally under 1.5 kg.
Got it: I'll focus on laptops under 1.5 kg with a strong integrated or entry-level discrete GPU.
Max has become a picky eater. He only eats chicken-flavored dog food.
Try mixing a new flavor into the chicken food a little at a time, and keep an eye on his energy and weight.
Also, I'm thinking about a trip to Bali at the end of the year. I want to check the visa first.
Many passports can get a visa on arrival in Indonesia. Make sure your passport is valid for at least six more months.
Some news: I changed jobs last month. I'm now an AI product manager at an e-commerce company in Singapore.
Congratulations! Going from recommendations to AI products is a great move. Settling in to Singapore?
Still settling in. The move was expensive, so I want to lower my laptop budget to 6,000 RMB.
No problem. There are still plenty of laptops under 1.5 kg at 6,000 RMB.
Max came to Singapore with me too. He loves walking in East Coast Park.
Wonderful! East Coast Park has a sea breeze and plenty of space for dogs. Just avoid the midday heat.
